description: Example Claude Code settings showing Bot Army integration hooks. Copy patterns to your own .claude/settings.json

PostToolUse.description: On session start, fetch Bot Army system health and inject into context

commands.command: nats request --server nats://localhost:4222 bridge.synapse.awareness '{}' --timeout 5s 2>/dev/null | jq -c '.data | {bots: (.bots | length), health: .health_status}' || echo '{"status": "bridge unavailable"}'

PostToolUse.description: Before editing a bot source file, check if there are open GTD tasks for that bot

commands.command: BOT=$(basename $(dirname $(dirname $(pwd)))) && nats request --server nats://localhost:4222 bridge.task.search "{\"query\": \"$BOT\", \"filters\": {\"status\": [\"open\"]}" --timeout 5s 2>/dev/null | jq -c '.data.tasks[] | {title, context}' | head -5 || true
commands.description: Find open tasks for this bot
commands.passOutputToPrompt: Inject these open tasks into context so you can coordinate work

PostToolUse.description: When working on a complex bot, inject its graph context for better understanding

commands.command: REPO=/Users/abby/code/elixir_bots && nats request --server nats://localhost:4222 bridge.graph.query "{\"repo_path\": \"$REPO\"}" --timeout 30s 2>/dev/null | jq -c '.data.graph | {entities: (.entities | length), relationships: (.relationships | length), summary: .summary}' || echo 'Graph unavailable'
commands.description: Fetch codebase knowledge graph for context
commands.passOutputToPrompt: This is the codebase structure snapshot—use it to understand dependencies and related modules

PostToolUse.description: When starting any editing session, fetch today's briefing for context

commands.command: nats request --server nats://localhost:4222 bridge.chronicle.daily.brief '{"presentation": "plain", "live": true}' --timeout 30s 2>/dev/null | jq -c '.data | {generated_at, opening: .opening[0:2], signals: .signals}' || echo '{"status": "briefing unavailable"}'
commands.passOutputToPrompt: Here's today's status. Use this to prioritize your work—focus on any degraded systems or high-priority tasks
